semantics.age: formed-mass weighted global host age, constant SFR bins, WMAP9 cosmic-time ceiling; not progenitor delay
semantics.dust: diffuse stellar attenuation and young-star total attenuation; neither is SN line-of-sight extinction
semantics.mass: total formed mass; surviving stellar mass would require model-dependent mass loss
semantics.posterior: SBI++ conditioned on empirical training mixture and photometric selection; not prior-free likelihood
semantics.joint_draws: derived quantities preserve HDF5 row alignment; independent author NPY resampling is bypassed
semantics.photometry: author foreground-corrected global aperture flux in maggies;1percent error floor included; no released interband covariance
semantics.YSE: exact identifiers and SN positions checked; actual redshift uncertainty and epoch/sample selection remain additional requirements
